steps.title: Identity verification recorded on the ticket
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0472. For each of the 25 sampled resets, obtain the ServiceNow SD ticket (EV-01) and inspect the mandatory 'Identity Verification' section.
acceptance_criteria: The Identity Verification section is present on the ticket.
The section names the verification factors used.
The section records the verification outcome.
The section records the verification timestamp.
The section records the acting agent.
refusal_criteria: The Identity Verification section is absent or blank.
Any of the four required fields (factors, outcome, timestamp, acting agent) is missing.
The EV-01 ticket export for the sampled reset is not provided.

steps.title: At least two approved factors applied
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0472. For each sampled ticket, inspect the recorded verification factors in EV-01 and, where Factor A was used, the Mobile Authenticator push log (EV-02).
acceptance_criteria: At least two of the three approved factors (A push challenge, B record challenge, C visual confirmation) are recorded.
Every recorded factor shows a successfully completed outcome.
refusal_criteria: Fewer than two factors are recorded.
A recorded factor shows a failed or partial outcome.
EV-01 is missing for the sampled reset.

steps.title: Only approved factors and attributes used
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0472. Where Factor B was used, inspect the three attributes challenged on the EV-01 ticket. Where Factor A was used, agree the challenge to the Mobile Authenticator log (EV-02).
acceptance_criteria: Every Factor B attribute is drawn from the Verify-ID record.
No Factor B attribute is available in the public corporate directory.
Every recorded Factor A challenge appears in EV-02 for the colleague's registered device with a successful response.
refusal_criteria: A public corporate directory attribute was used as a Factor B challenge.
A recorded Factor A challenge has no corresponding entry in EV-02.
EV-02 is missing where Factor A was recorded.

steps.title: Verification precedes the reset
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0472. Compare the identity verification timestamp on the EV-01 ticket to the reset execution timestamp in the ADX audit log extract (EV-03).
acceptance_criteria: The verification timestamp is earlier than the reset execution timestamp.
Verification and reset were performed by the same agent ID.
refusal_criteria: The reset was executed before verification.
The reset was executed without verification.
The reset was executed by an agent other than the one who verified.
EV-01 or EV-03 is missing for the sampled reset.

steps.title: Rejected requests handled
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0472. Obtain all requests in the testing period closed as 'Rejected — identity not verified' (EV-01) and inspect the related SEC incident ticket (EV-04).
acceptance_criteria: No password reset was executed for the rejected request.
A SEC incident was raised for the rejected request.
The SEC incident was raised within one hour of the attempt.
refusal_criteria: A reset was executed despite failed verification.
No SEC incident was raised.
The SEC incident was raised more than one hour after the attempt.
EV-04 is missing for a rejected request.

steps.title: Temporary password generation parameters
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0473. Inspect the ADX Password Reset Tool configuration (EV-05) in force during the testing period. Tested once for the period, not per sampled item.
acceptance_criteria: Temporary password length is at least 12 characters.
Complexity settings match Password Baseline BL-SEC-012.
Generation is system-performed with no agent override available.
refusal_criteria: Length is below 12 characters.
Complexity deviates from BL-SEC-012.
An agent-editable password field is present.
EV-05 does not cover the full testing period.

steps.title: Temporary password validity window
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0473. Inspect the configured expiry setting in EV-05, then agree it to the generation and expiry timestamps in the ADX audit log extract (EV-03) for each sampled reset. The configuration attribute is tested once for the period.
acceptance_criteria: The configured validity does not exceed 60 minutes.
For every sampled reset, the expiry timestamp is no more than 60 minutes after generation.
refusal_criteria: The configured validity is above 60 minutes.
Any sampled item has an expiry beyond 60 minutes after generation.
EV-05 or EV-03 is missing.

steps.title: Forced change at first logon
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0473. For each sampled reset, inspect the forced-change flag recorded in the ADX audit log extract (EV-03).
acceptance_criteria: The 'User must change password at next logon' flag is set for every sampled account at the time of reset.
refusal_criteria: The flag is not set.
The flag was removed before first logon.
EV-03 does not contain the sampled reset.

steps.title: Single use enforced
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0473. For each sampled reset, inspect authentication events following issuance of the temporary password in the ADX audit log extract (EV-03).
acceptance_criteria: The temporary password authenticates at most once.
Any subsequent authentication attempt with the same credential is rejected, or the credential is shown as invalidated.
refusal_criteria: More than one successful authentication with the same temporary password.
EV-03 does not contain first-use events for the sampled reset.

steps.title: Approved delivery channel
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0473. For each sampled reset, agree the delivery record in the SMS gateway delivery log (EV-06) and the ServiceNow ticket (EV-01) to the registered mobile number or to the manager secure-link route.
acceptance_criteria: Delivery was made to the colleague's registered mobile number, or via secure link to the line manager where no mobile number is registered.
There is no evidence of delivery by e-mail, chat or verbal communication.
refusal_criteria: Delivery was made to an unregistered number.
The ticket indicates the password was read out, or sent by e-mail or chat.
EV-06 has no delivery record for the sampled reset.

steps.title: Reconciliation timeliness
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0474. For each month in the testing period (January, February, March 2026), inspect the monthly reconciliation workbook (EV-07) and the reviewer approval e-mail (EV-10) for completion and approval dates.
acceptance_criteria: The reconciliation was completed on or before the 10th working day following month end.
The reconciliation was approved on or before the 10th working day following month end.
refusal_criteria: Completion after the 10th working day following month end.
Approval after the 10th working day following month end.
No completion or approval date is evidenced.
EV-07 or EV-10 is missing for a month.

steps.title: Population completeness
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0474. For each month, agree the record count of the ADX audit extract used in the reconciliation workbook (EV-07) to the ADX source record count for the same month (EV-03).
acceptance_criteria: Record counts agree, or differences are explained and supported within the workbook.
The extract period covers the full month.
refusal_criteria: Counts differ with no supported explanation.
The extract period does not cover the full month.

steps.title: Reconciliation performed
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0474. For each month, inspect the matching performed in the reconciliation workbook (EV-07) between reset events and approved tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Every reset event in the month is either matched to an approved ticket with a completed Identity Verification section, or recorded as an exception.
refusal_criteria: Reset events are left unmatched and not recorded as exceptions.
Reset events are matched to tickets lacking a completed Identity Verification section.

steps.title: Exception handling
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0474. For every exception raised in the testing period, inspect the IAM Exception Register entry (EV-08), the investigation notes and the closure date.
acceptance_criteria: Each exception was investigated and closed within five working days.
Any exception confirmed as an unauthorised reset was escalated to the CISO office the same working day.
A SEC incident was raised the same working day for any confirmed unauthorised reset.
refusal_criteria: An exception is open beyond five working days without documented justification.
A confirmed unauthorised reset was not escalated the same working day.
EV-08 is missing.

steps.title: Independent review
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0474. For each month, inspect the reviewer approval e-mail (EV-10) and compare the approver to the preparer named in the reconciliation workbook (EV-07).
acceptance_criteria: Approval was given by the IAM Operations Manager or a documented delegate.
The approver is a different person from the preparer.
The approval is dated on or after the date the workbook was completed.
refusal_criteria: Self-approval by the preparer.
Approval by a person other than the IAM Operations Manager or a documented delegate.
Approval dated before the workbook was completed.
EV-10 is missing for a month.

steps.title: Factor B challenges all three Verify-ID attributes
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0472, control details section 3.1. Where Factor B was used on a sampled ticket (EV-01), confirm the caller answered all three required attributes. No test plan step checks the number or identity of the attributes.
acceptance_criteria: The caller was challenged on employee number, cost centre code and line manager name.
All three attributes were answered correctly.
refusal_criteria: Fewer than three attributes were challenged.
An attribute other than employee number, cost centre code or line manager name was used.
Any attribute was answered incorrectly and Factor B was still recorded as passed.

steps.title: Agent mismatch recorded as reconciliation exception
steps.description: CTL-IAM-0474, control details section 3.3. For each month, inspect the reconciliation workbook (EV-07) and the IAM Exception Register (EV-08) for reset events where the acting agent differs from the agent named on the ticket. Step 0474-03 covers missing tickets and incomplete verification, but not agent mismatches.
acceptance_criteria: Every reset event where the acting agent differs from the agent named on the ticket is recorded as an exception in the IAM Exception Register.
refusal_criteria: A reset event with an agent mismatch is treated as matched and not recorded as an exception.
The workbook does not compare the acting agent to the agent named on the ticket.
